title: EFN - Rekonsiliasi Liabilitas Poin per PT
description: G21 (docs/04 §13.1 no. 7): saldo akun Liabilitas Poin per PT di Odoo vs closing_liability_idr BFF setelah akrual harian (cron Odoo 02:00 WIB). Sumber: log EFN_LOYALTY_RECON (Loki stream efn_loyalty, loyalty_event=liability_recon; tanpa data pribadi). diff = Odoo - BFF. Alert: loki-rules/efn-loyalty.yml grup efn-loyalty-liability-recon (warning bila selisih != 0, critical bila |selisih| > ambang, PLACEHOLDER Rp 100.000). Tidak ada koreksi otomatis.

panels.title: |Selisih| terakhir per PT (Rp, 26 jam)
panels.description: Nilai absolut diff_idr baris terakhir per PT. Kuning = selisih ada (warning), merah = di atas ambang critical (samakan dengan efn-loyalty.yml).

targets.expr: max by (company_code) (last_over_time({stream="efn_loyalty", loyalty_event="liability_recon"} | regexp `"diff_idr": ?-?(?P<diff_abs>\d+)` | unwrap diff_abs | __error__="" [26h]))

panels.title: PT yang tercatat (26 jam)
panels.description: Jumlah PT dengan baris rekonsiliasi dalam 26 jam. Kurang dari jumlah PT aktif = akrual PT itu gagal/terlewat (cek aktivitas Finance di Odoo).

targets.expr: count(max by (company_code) (last_over_time({stream="efn_loyalty", loyalty_event="liability_recon"} | regexp `"diff_idr": ?-?(?P<diff_abs>\d+)` | unwrap diff_abs | __error__="" [26h])) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Selisih (Odoo - BFF) per PT (Rp)
panels.description: Bertanda: positif = liabilitas di Odoo lebih besar dari BFF; negatif = lebih kecil.

targets.expr: max by (company_code) (last_over_time({stream="efn_loyalty", loyalty_event="liability_recon"} | regexp `"diff_idr": ?(?P<diff>-?\d+)` | unwrap diff | __error__="" [26h]))

panels.title: Liabilitas poin per PT: Odoo vs BFF (Rp)

targets.expr: max by (company_code) (last_over_time({stream="efn_loyalty", loyalty_event="liability_recon"} | regexp `"odoo_liability_idr": ?(?P<odoo>-?\d+)` | unwrap odoo | __error__="" [26h]))
max by (company_code) (last_over_time({stream="efn_loyalty", loyalty_event="liability_recon"} | regexp `"bff_closing_liability_idr": ?(?P<bff>-?\d+)` | unwrap bff | __error__="" [26h]))

panels.title: Baris EFN_LOYALTY_RECON (Odoo)
panels.description: Satu baris per PT per tanggal akrual. Tanpa data pribadi (skema dibatasi promtail tahap 2c).
